name: Nozokimi Vibration ~Nozoite Ijitte Tanoshinde~
original_name: 覗き見バイブレーション ～覗いて弄って楽しんで～
source:
Peeing up skirts and using toys is easy as pie these days.
That's because in this happy world, how to get a good look...... isn't a problem.

I've been doing a lot more than look. I look and then I play.
This is essential!

"W-w-w-w-w-w-w-whhyyyy are you doing that--!!?"

Girls are every bit as perverted as me, all it takes is first contact.
My toys are liberators for girls who were too afraid to indulge themselves.

Don't worry, girls, nothing to fear.
Toys are meant for pleasure. Say hello to my little friends!
